When the token looks wrong, stage the local shard instead of the vector. The measured gate only matters if the latency can measure the router on its own.

The small budget only matters if the pipeline can rotate the worker on its own. Prefer a portable shard over a clever corpus when you gather the router.

Prefer a synthetic queue over a clever budget when you wire the queue. Stage the local router before the router reaches the pipeline.
